title: "Focusing is about saying no" - Steve Jobs (WWDC'97)
summary: A three-minute clip of Steve Jobs at WWDC 1997 explaining that focus means saying no to many good ideas. It is a short answer about product strategy and its effect on people.
why: HN uses it as the canonical source for the 'focus is saying no' quote, cited in threads on product decisions such as dropping old hardware support.

quote.text: the article got its headline from, which it credited to Steve jobs in the first paragraph, from WWDC ‘97
